labs.title: Create a Dataverse table and a canvas app in Power Apps
labs.summary: Build an Equipment Request table in Dataverse, add typed columns and rows, generate a canvas app from the table, publish it, and share it with least privilege.
labs.scenario: Contoso Facilities tracks equipment requests by email today. In the **simulated Power Apps** maker portal, create a Dataverse table named **Equipment Request**, add columns that use appropriate data types, enter a few sample rows, generate a canvas app from the table, and share the app with the **Equipment requesters** security group as **User**. Everything is simulated; no real environment or licensing change is used.
learningObjectives: Create a Microsoft Dataverse table with table properties and a primary column
Choose appropriate Dataverse column data types for dates, choices, numbers and people fields
Generate, save, publish and share a canvas app from a Dataverse table using least privilege
prerequisites: Know that Dataverse stores business data for Power Platform apps

components.text: Dataverse data types control validation and behavior. Use **Date Only** for dates, **Whole Number** for counts, **Choice** for controlled status values, and **Text** or **Lookup** for the requester depending on whether you need a relationship to a user/contact table.

checks.message: Request date should be Date Only. Text would not sort or validate as a date.

steps.title: Create the Equipment Request table
steps.instruction: Select **Tables**, select **+ New table**, and in **Table properties** enter display name **Equipment Request**, plural name **Equipment Requests**, and primary column **Request title**. Then select **Create**.
steps.hint: The environment name **Contoso (default)** appears in the portal header.
steps.explanation: Dataverse tables model business data. The primary column is the readable text value shown for each row.

rules.description: Equipment Request table exists with the correct primary column
rules.failureFeedback: Create a custom table named Equipment Request with plural name Equipment Requests and primary column Request title.

steps.title: Add typed Dataverse columns
steps.instruction: Select **+ New column** and add **Request date** as **Date Only**, **Status** as **Choice** with **New**, **Approved**, and **Rejected**, **Quantity** as **Whole Number**, and **Requested by** as **Text** or **Lookup**. Then select **Save**.
steps.hint: Avoid Text for Quantity or Request date. The simulator explains why if you choose the wrong type.
steps.explanation: Correct data types improve validation, sorting, filtering, formulas and flow conditions.

rules.failureFeedback: Request date must use Date Only, not Text.
Quantity must use Whole Number so numeric comparisons work.

steps.title: Add sample request rows
steps.instruction: Open **Edit data** and use **Add sample rows** to save three equipment request rows.
steps.hint: Rows are the records that canvas app browse, detail and edit screens will display.
steps.explanation: Dataverse stores rows centrally so Power Apps and Power Automate can use the same data.

rules.description: Equipment Request has at least three rows
rules.failureFeedback: Add at least three rows in Edit data.

steps.title: Generate a canvas app from Dataverse
steps.instruction: Go to **Apps**, select **+ Create**, choose **Start with data**, use data source **Dataverse**, select the **Equipment Requests** table, name the app **Equipment Requests Canvas**, and select **Create app**.
steps.hint: A canvas app gives you flexible screen design. A generated canvas app starts with browse, detail and edit screens.
steps.explanation: Canvas apps focus on the maker-designed user experience; model-driven apps are driven by Dataverse tables, forms, views and navigation.

rules.description: Canvas app was generated from Equipment Request

steps.hint: Publishing makes saved changes available. Sharing grants access; choose the least privilege role.
steps.explanation: Users need run access to use the app. Co-owner is for makers who edit and re-share the app.

labs.solution:
1. Select **Tables** and then **+ New table**.
2. In **Table properties**, enter display name `Equipment Request`, plural name `Equipment Requests`, primary column `Request title`, then select **Create**.
3. Select **+ New column**. Add **Request date** as **Date Only**, **Status** as **Choice** with `New; Approved; Rejected`, **Quantity** as **Whole Number**, and **Requested by** as **Text** or **Lookup**. Select **Save**.
4. Open **Edit data** and save three request rows.
5. Go to **Apps** > **+ Create** > **Start with data**. Select **Dataverse**, choose **Equipment Requests**, enter app name `Equipment Requests Canvas`, and select **Create app**.
6. In the generated canvas app, confirm the **Browse screen**, **Detail screen**, and **Edit screen** are present. Select **Save**, then **Publish**.
7. Select **Share**, choose **Equipment requesters**, set permission to **User**, and select **Share**.
